intro: Manhattan Chinatown is New York's oldest Chinese community, where many family businesses have operated for decades. Legal needs here cluster at two ends: estate and property matters for the older generation, and lease and employment issues in food service and retail. We understand the family-run model particular to Chinatown and provide consultation entirely in Chinese.

seo.title: Manhattan Chinatown Chinese Legal Consultation | Estates, Commercial Leases | Legal Dispute Help
seo.description: Chinese-language legal consultation for Manhattan Chinatown: probate, wills and trusts, property and co-ownership, commercial lease disputes, family business succession, and wage issues. Free initial assessment.
